messages:
Riley Gomez: FYI I just noticed a handful of scorecards from yesterday's IC hiring loop didn't attach to the candidate profiles. Interviewers say they completed them in the mobile app. Looks like the webhook that converts mobile submissions to ATS attachments dropped a header rename after last week's webhook refactor.

Recruiter Bot: Webhook delivery summary for 2026-07-11: 21 deliveries, 4 failures (422). Endpoint: https://ats.example/webhooks/mobile-submissions. See logs: https://logs.redwood/webhooks/2026-07-11/mobile

Jules Becker: Ugh — we pushed the rename from "sc_card" -> "scorecard" in staging but forgot prod mapping. That explains the 422s. I can patch the mapping in the proxy in ~15m. In the meantime we should surface a manual 'attach scorecard' button on the candidate view for recruiters so they can attach mobile submissions without needing interviewers to re-upload.

Priya S: Manual button would help. Also, we should send a one-off email to interviewers explaining the temporary workaround. Some interviewers are on vacation this week. Can we add a pre-made email template?

Emily (People Ops): Yes — I'll draft a short note and post it in #hiring-toolkit. Suggested text: "Heads up: if you submitted a scorecard from the mobile app between 7/11 08:00-12:00 UTC, please re-open the submission page and re-submit or notify your recruiter. We're patching the webhook; recruiters can also attach from the candidate page." Keep it short.

Riley Gomez: Patch deployed by Jules: proxy mapping updated to accept both sc_card and scorecard; webhook now returns 200 for recent deliveries. Jules, can you also run a backfill to reprocess failed deliveries?

Jules Becker: Yes. I'll trigger a reprocess job:```bash
POST /internal/webhooks/reprocess
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "source": "mobile-submissions",
  "from": "2026-07-11T07:00:00Z",
  "to": "2026-07-11T13:00:00Z"
}
```
I expect the job to finish in ~10m and attach any found scorecards. I'll post job link when done.

Recruiter Bot: Reprocess job started: job_20260711_reproc_83. Current status: running.

Priya S: While that's running can we also lock down the canonical scorecard template? Some interviewers used the uncalibrated internal template which causes rating drift. I'd like to set a policy that only the 'Calibrated Interviewer' template is allowed for IC hire reqs. Implementation idea: add a blacklist for templates in the req config UI.

Emily (People Ops): Good idea. I'll open a change request for the hiring config to default to 'Calibrated Interviewer' and mark others as optional with a tooltip explaining reasons. Also scheduling: who should attend a quick 20-min refresh on template usage? I'd push to engineering hiring leads + frequent interviewers.

Riley Gomez: Engineering hiring leads + top 30 interviewers works. Can we have two sessions: one during EMEA-friendly hours (Tue 8:30 UTC) and one in a US slot (Wed 20:00 UTC) next week? Keep recording and add to hiring toolkit.

Jules Becker: Reprocess job finished: job_20260711_reproc_83. Summary: 4 deliveries reprocessed, 3 scorecards attached, 1 missing file (uploader retried or deleted) -> flagged for manual follow-up. Link: https://internal.jobs/job_20260711_reproc_83

Recruiter Bot: Ticket created: HIRE-2876 (webhook-scorecard-backfill) assigned to Jules Becker.

Priya S: I'll follow up on the single missing one and ping the interviewer. Emily: can you post the training invites + RSVP form? I'll also add a short 5-question micro-quiz to verify people read the guide.

Emily (People Ops): Putting invites on calendar now and creating a simple Google Form for RSVP + micro-quiz. Draft agenda: 1) Why calibrated templates matter (3m) 2) How to pick the right template (4m) 3) Demo: attaching/re-attaching scorecards (8m) 4) Q&A (5m). Recording link will be added to the hiring toolkit + I'll paste the RSVP link here when ready.

Riley Gomez: Thanks all. Two final asks: 1) add an hourly alert that surfaces any webhook 4xx spikes and 2) add a small banner in the candidate UI when an interview has no attached scorecard and completed_at is set (text: "Scorecard missing: recruiter action required"). Both reduce future noise.

Jules Becker: I'll add the alert to the webhook monitoring (name: Webhook: mobile submissions 4xx rate).

Emily (People Ops): I'll file a front-end ticket for the missing-scorecard banner and include copy + acceptance criteria. Ticket: INT-4684. ETA for banner: next sprint.

Recruiter Bot: HIRE-2876 updated: Jules Becker marked job complete. INT-4684 created and linked.

Riley Gomez: Cool. Closing the loop  thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

Emily (People Ops): Closing notes: recruiters notified, backfill completed for majority, training invites scheduled, front-end banner ticket filed. I'll follow up with analytics on post-fix missing-rate next week.
